title: Arrived dead
text:
Horribly disappointing experience. My special needs son adores succulents and I thought this would be a fun experience to receive a new one each month and teach him how to care for them. Unfortunately our initial shipment arrived with a dead plant instead of the living healthy “golden ball cactus” we were supposed to receive. At first I thought maybe it was a seedling that we were supposed to grow, however upon closer inspection the plant simply didn’t survive the shipping process, or wasn’t healthy to begin with.

Furthermore, I evidently didn’t read the description well enough and had expected the succulent to arrive a cute pot, and not a cheap plastic one. Even had the plant been healthy, this drastically decreased the overall value I was expecting. I can go to Walmart and purchase 2-3 succulents at this price. It won’t be the fun experience I woad hoping for, but at least the plants have a better survival rate. Really disheartening and I feel terrible for the poor plant.

Subscription canceled.
